given_when_then.given: The Platform Operator has access to the zone management module
given_when_then.when: The operator creates a new polygon boundary for a delivery zone and publishes it
given_when_then.then: The system stores the new definition as the active version and invalidates the previous zone map

given_when_then.given: A new version of a Service Area Definition is published
given_when_then.when: The Order Allocation Engine processes an Order Request for an address outside the new service area
given_when_then.then: The Order Allocation Engine must reject the order as per rule 2

given_when_then.given: A new version of a Service Area Definition is published
given_when_then.when: The system recalculates travel time matrices for the updated Service Area Definition
given_when_then.then: The system must update the travel time matrix to reflect the new route constraints

given_when_then.given: A new version of a Service Area Definition is published
given_when_then.then: The log must contain a timestamp and the identity of the Platform Operator as per rule 4

given_when_then.given: The system invalidates existing Delivery Zone Maps upon publication of a new Service Area Definition version
given_when_then.when: The system assigns a Delivery Assignment to an existing Order Request
given_when_then.then: The Delivery Assignment must not reference the old Delivery Zone Map, as it has been invalidated

success_criteria: The system must automatically invalidate existing Delivery Zone Maps upon publication of a new version of a Service Area Definition.
The system must reject Orders originating from addresses outside the active Service Area Definition.
The system must recalculate travel time matrices whenever a Service Area Definition is modified.
The system must log all modifications to Service Area Definitions with a timestamp and the identity of the Platform Operator.
